_comment: EP-17 snippet_for parity fixture (match-centred-snippets.md T-12). The Python (src/python/tests/test_ep17_snippets.py) and TypeScript (src/ts/tests/ep17-snippets.test.ts) bindings must return each case's `expected` exactly; the fathomdb-py Rust test snippet::parity_fixture_tests checks that the binding conversions plus fathomdb_engine::snippet_for reproduce it. Offsets are UTF-8 byte offsets [start, end). `options` keys are the Python field names (TypeScript camelCases them); an absent key is the default. Spans or options that do not fit u32/u8 are ignored or saturated by the bindings.
